site_name: Bus Shelter D And Advertising Right Outside Putney Station And 163
description: Display of 2 x Internally Illuminated sequential advertisement screens, with static and dynamic content display capability and automatic rotation of images.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION, Letter dated "16th of January 2026", Letter dated "January 2026".
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 2 - The maximum steady brightness of the projecting sign hereby permitted is not to exceed 300 candelas per sq.m. 
Reason: To ensure the proposed sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 3 - The illumination of the signs hereby permitted shall be by static illumination only. 
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - The advertisement hereby approved shall not display any animated or video
content unless it is below the VAMM maximum threshold.
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the
locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway of  Putney High Street 
should not be blocked during the relocation and installation works. Temporary obstructions during the development works should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on Putney High Street. All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
